newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian goods/services in surplus in February.
newsitem.headline: Australian goods/services in surplus in February.

text.p: Australia's seasonally-adjusted balance on goods and services showed a surplus of A$336 million in February compared to January's deficit of A$38 million (revised from a A$63 million deficit), the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
This compares with a seasonally adjusted deficit of A$120 million in February 1996.
Economists' median forecast had been for a deficit of A$13 million for the balance of goods and services.
EXPORTS: Rural goods 2.079 bln 1.984 bln 1.855 bln
IMPORTS: Consumption goods 1.872 bln 1.732 bln 1.688 bln
Balance of goods/svcs +336 million -38 million -120 million

The Bureau said the trend estimate on the balance of goods and services recorded a surplus of A$144 million in February, the 12th consecutive surplus in this balance and the longest run of monthly surpluses since May 1992.
